setup: CREATE TABLE items AS SELECT i::BIGINT AS item_id, ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'][1 + i] AS kind FROM range(4) t(i)
CREATE TABLE buys AS SELECT i::BIGINT AS buy_id, (i % 8)::BIGINT AS user_id, ((i * 3) % 4)::BIGINT AS item_id, TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01' + to_days((i * 5)::INTEGER) AS ts FROM range(120) t(i)
input.pql: PREDICT LIST_DISTINCT(buys.item_id, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

view.name: view_metric_link
view.yaml:
version: 0.1
source: "`{catalog}`.`{schema}`.buys"
joins:
  - name: users
    source: "`{catalog}`.`{schema}`.users"
    on: source.user_id = users.user_id
  - name: items
    source: "`{catalog}`.`{schema}`.items"
    on: source.item_id = items.item_id
dimensions:
  - name: buy_id
    expr: source.buy_id
  - name: user_id
    expr: source.user_id
  - name: item_id
    expr: source.item_id
  - name: ts
    expr: source.ts
  - name: kind
    expr: items.kind
  - name: country
    expr: users.country
measures:
  - name: purchases
    expr: COUNT(1)

why: A temporal foreign-key LIST_DISTINCT query through the existing metric view, without ranking decomposition. Both ordered entity roles and list labels must survive view conversion, materialization and the original scripted endpoint refusal.
